summary: An education dispute brings strikers out during a term that has gone well in other areas.
realLife: owner, Nov 8: A generally successful term can still leave one group with grounds for a strike.
inGame: needs: read the education-specific grievance and the term’s other outcomes alongside the recorded strike.

turns.what: The education dispute reaches a settlement after the term ends.
turns.pulledBy: The negotiating parties are still meeting when the successor takes office.
turns.writesBack: The strike and settlement fall under different terms.
